sablefix.panel.about_ver: Sable Fix Core v1.1.0 — Sable save self-healing & diagnostics
sablefix.panel.about_what1: Sable (Aeronautics) ships and airships live in separate sublevel files.
sablefix.panel.about_what2: Corrupted pointers there fail silently — structures just vanish;
sablefix.panel.about_what3: and a stalled server gets killed by the vanilla watchdog after 60 s,
sablefix.panel.about_what4: with no clue why. This mod targets exactly these two problems.
sablefix.panel.about_passive1: 1. Verifies every slvlr/slvls pointer table at startup;
sablefix.panel.about_passive2: 2. Parses force-load tickets, counts and damage at a glance;
sablefix.panel.about_passive3: 3. Everything is logged to the Runtime Log tab.
sablefix.panel.about_watch1: A healthy main thread ticks 20 times a second. After 20 s of silence,
sablefix.panel.about_watch2: it writes a full thread dump to logs/sablefix/ — before the 60 s kill,
sablefix.panel.about_watch3: so next time it stalls, open the report and you see
sablefix.panel.about_watch4: exactly who is waiting on whom. No more guessing.
sablefix.panel.about_readonly1: Scans never modify your save. Future repair features
sablefix.panel.about_readonly2: will always require your explicit confirmation.
